snippet.title: saurabhschool
snippet.description:
Saurabh School of Computing is an initiative by IITian S.Saurabh. He is B.Tech from IIT and MS from USA.  This channel provides quality and easy to understand video lessons to help people prepare for programming interviews . 

Please help this channel by making some donation through this link
http://igg.me/at/saurabhschool/x

Recommended books 
1.  "programming interviews exposed 3rd edition" by Eric Giguère
2. "cracking the coding interview 5th edition" by gayle laakman
keywords:
"coding interview", "coding interview questions","coding interview pdf", "coding interview questions pdf", "software interview questions" , "software interview questions and answers", "google interview questions", 
,"programming interview", "programming interview questions"
